# zlib / example_large_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `example_large_fuzzer` ([source](source/example_large_fuzzer.c), unmodified) over zlib 1.3.1 (madler/zlib at 51b7f2ab).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, an invariant: Deflate a zero buffer, then already-compressed bytes at level 0, then the zero buffer again; inflate total_out must equal exactly 2*uncomprLen + diff. Length only; failure prints + returns 0.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zlib 1.3.1 at commit 51b7f2ab.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- deflate must be greedy (avail_in == 0 after the first call) and Z_FINISH must return Z_STREAM_END; print + return 0 ([lines 48-72](source/example_large_fuzzer.c#L48-L72)): prints only; not confirmed in the binary.
- Deflate a zero buffer, then already-compressed bytes at level 0, then the zero buffer again; inflate total_out must equal exactly 2*uncomprLen + diff. Length only; failure prints + returns 0 ([lines 108-111](source/example_large_fuzzer.c#L108-L111)): prints only; not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch zlib` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `example_large_fuzzer.plain` | 97,008 | `6d58d47af15aad0b6bac2289fe1bd70c5a304f31b0fb7c0767c5b4ecffba485c` |
| ubsan | `example_large_fuzzer.ubsan` | 109,176 | `e2b9974553a7b844ff071dd7871e5f862285dc839d055e94c156bb815ecf74bb` |
| asan | `example_large_fuzzer.asan` | 713,176 | `e858a3e946f3b6fd91d3fa501200f3c48db678bbfa2bebf4e0442d85f9b396b9` |
| asan-ubsan | `example_large_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 724,280 | `8b60e920fe42ffccbb0220bf5ca40bdd6cf9947c5ecf236c48fdb5a14671e38d` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
